unit: Integrated LLM/tool/observation/permission system for bounded digital work
gate_1: System boundary defined; not all GenAI
gate_2: A plausible reduction in direct expert effort, not demonstrated removal of a categorical human constraint

criteria.rationale: No matched, quality-adjusted end-to-end ratio for the defined system; benchmark success and adjacent productivity cannot supply it.
Dynamic delegation is a plausible category change; continuity with prior automation and no demonstrated barrier dissolution remain.
Digital delivery is technically replicable; broad distribution and actual access for this agentic system are unmeasured.
Lower skill barriers are plausible, but usable access and control distribution are not established.
Tool composition can enable other workflows; an observed agent-attributed cross-domain cascade is not supplied.
Possible tiers include labor, governance and knowledge; durable observed change and suppression-test evidence are missing.

verdict: Withhold a definitive general class; potentially Promethean remains an unconfirmed hypothesis, not the submitted affirmative verdict
confidence: High in need for distinctions; low in long-range empirical classification
scoring: No numeric sum or threshold; unknown is not contradicted
